name: 卡娅
src: 月银纪史诗/第十歌_千鼓空角.md:259
who: Kaya, a wolf-eared beastfolk thunder-hunter from the foot of the Crown Peak, twenty-five: about 170 cm, long-legged and strong, with legs that can run the mountain all day without tiring. Long silver-grey hair tied in one high ponytail, a pair of pointed wolf ears on top of her head (and no human ears at the sides of the head) with a tuft of black hair on each tip that turn toward every sound. Amber-yellow eyes with narrow vertical pupils that look straight at people. A wild, handsome face with a straight nose and two small sharp canines showing when she laughs. A bushy grey wolf tail behind her. A free, fierce, bright air.
face: FACE, as in the references: a wild, attractive beastfolk woman's face with amber-yellow eyes and narrow slit pupils, a straight nose, a wide mouth with two small sharp canines when she laughs, wolf ears with a black tuft on each tip on top of the head and NO human ears; she looks twenty-five. Her pupils are narrow VERTICAL slits like a cat's in daylight, drawn as a thin dark upright slit inside the amber iris in every panel and in every expression, never round.
build: 170 cm, long-legged and lean-strong, a C-cup, a slim waist and firm hips.
palette: silver grey and amber, dark leather brown, iron grey, tooth white
casual: Her hunter's clothes: a close-fitting hide hunting suit in dark brown, a short cloak over the shoulders with a ring of wolf teeth sewn along its edge, laced boots; on her back a spear whose shaft is one piece of solid iron, a thunder-hunter uses iron, never wood, because iron draws the lightning; a copper bell at her belt on the left hand side. A free, bright, closed-mouth grin.
private: Back in the foothill hut: the short cloak off, a long-sleeved loose undyed wool tunic to the thighs over soft leggings and house shoes, the ponytail loose, the tail curled round her side. She holds a bowl of stew in both hands, a lopsided, sleepy grin with a hint of canine.
battle: Hunting the storm: the hide hunting suit, the wolf-tooth cloak thrown back, leather bracers, a belt with the copper bell on the left hand side. She holds the iron-shafted spear in both hands low and ready, the point forward, the ears flat back and the tail low, the amber eyes narrowed; a fierce, focused look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: a low hunter's stance, the knees bent and the weight forward, both hands gripping an iron-shafted spear with the point forward, the ears laid back and the amber eyes narrowed, a fierce, focused look and the mouth closed.
formal: Invited to the lowland hall: a clean short dark-green wool tunic dress to the knee over leggings, a belt of woven leather with the copper bell, a short cloak edged with wolf teeth, the ponytail tied with a new leather cord. She stands straight, the ears upright, the hands behind her back, a stiff, slightly embarrassed grin.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the camera tilted, the amber eyes looking at the viewer with a bright fierce grin showing two small sharp canines, the wolf ears pricked toward the viewer. Cold silver-blue storm light from one side on the silver-grey hair. Foreground blur: dark rain streaks and a distant flash of lightning. She wears the wolf-tooth cloak over the hide hunting suit.

name: 洛萨
src: 月银纪史诗/第十歌_千鼓空角.md:316
who: Lothar, a human prince of the Peak kingdom and commander of the allied host, thirty: about 186 cm, wide-shouldered and straight-backed, strong enough to hold a shield covered with three layers of storm hide above his head all day. Short flax-coloured hair cut even, winter-lake blue eyes that look first at where a person is standing, a handsome, well-cut face with a little stubble that he has not shaved off. From the side of his neck to his left shoulder (on the viewer's right when they face us) a pale silver fern-shaped mark, the path lightning took through him, silver-white and faded from red. A grave, thoughtful air; he has not smiled since the white forest. Nothing he wears is metal: no steel, no iron, no shine of polished metal anywhere on him in any panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a handsome, well-cut young man's face, winter-lake blue eyes, straight eyebrows, a firm closed mouth with a trace of stubble on the chin; on the side of the neck, a thin silver-white fern-shaped lightning mark (on the viewer's right when they face us), clearly visible above the collar. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 186 cm, tall, wide-shouldered, a straight back.
palette: flax gold and winter-lake blue, deep blue wool, storm-hide grey, a little silver-white
casual: A prince's travelling clothes: a deep-blue cloak of the Peak kingdom embroidered with a pair of white antlers, the clasp a plain dry-wood toggle, a deep-blue wool tunic, dark trousers and leather boots; he wears not one piece of iron on his body. At his belt a worn sheepskin notebook. A grave, quiet look.
private: In the camp tent at night: no cloak, a long-sleeved linen shirt open at the throat showing the silver fern mark, wool trousers, soft boots. He holds the sheepskin notebook closed in one hand, a tired, absent look.
battle: Commanding the host with no iron on him: a rounded helmet of fired clay with a dark brown-black glossy glaze, plainly pottery, a quilted leather-and-wool jerkin, a deep-blue cloak with the white antlers on his back, a big round shield covered with three layers of storm-wolf hide on his left arm, and in his right hand a long spear of dry wood with a fire-hardened wooden point, a thin thread of storm-light along the shaft. A set, grave look.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced behind a raised shield on the left arm, the long dry-wood spear held forward in the right hand at shoulder height, the feet planted wide and the weight forward, a set, grave look and the mouth closed.
formal: In the great hall of the Peak kingdom: a long deep-blue wool robe edged with a band of white antler embroidery, the white-antler cloak with a polished wooden toggle, a plain circlet of dry wood, no iron on him. He stands very straight, a grave, quiet look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the winter-lake blue eyes looking at the viewer with a heavy, tired steadiness, the lips closed. Cold pale light from one side, the silver fern mark on the neck faintly glowing. Foreground blur: drifting snow and the dark edge of a storm-hide shield. He wears the deep-blue cloak with the white antlers.

name: 温妲
src: 月银纪史诗/第十歌_千鼓空角.md:372
who: Winda, an old human midwife of the foot of the Crown Peak, eighty: about 156 cm, small and thin, with a slight stoop. Snow-white hair rolled into a bun at the back and held with one bone hairpin. A deeply lined face, yet her eyes are a bright new-leaf green, like the first leaf of spring. In her youth she was the most beautiful girl in the foothills, and she still shows it when she smiles. Small, dry, very clean hands with nails cut short; hands that have not trembled in sixty-five years. A calm, kind, steady air; a mother who looks at her is no longer afraid.
face: FACE, as in the references: a very old woman's kindly face, deeply lined across the brow and around the eyes and mouth, bright new-leaf green eyes, thin white eyebrows, a small straight nose and a gentle mouth with a faint smile; the face of a once-lovely girl still visible.
build: 156 cm, small and thin, a slight stoop, small steady clean hands.
palette: indigo blue and apron white, snow white hair, new-leaf green, willow brown
casual: Her midwife's clothes: a long indigo-blue coarse cloth dress to the ankles with long sleeves, a clean white apron whose pocket holds a pair of small silver scissors and a roll of boiled linen; on her back a wicker willow box of herbs, a hot-water flask and a small oil lamp. A calm, kind look.
private: At home by the stove: the apron off, a long-sleeved, high-collared grey wool dress, a knitted shawl over the shoulders, thick stockings and house shoes, the white bun loosened with the bone pin still in. She holds a warm cup in both small hands, a gentle faint smile.
battle: Not a fighter, going up the mountain at night: a heavy dark wool cloak over the indigo dress, the white apron tied on, a walking stick of pale willow in the right hand, the wicker box on her back, a small lit oil lamp held in the left hand. A steady, unafraid look.
battle_pose: 3) the night-road outfit: standing steady and unafraid, a walking stick in the right hand and a small oil lamp held up in the left, the wicker box on her back, a calm look; she is a midwife, not a fighter, and carries no weapon.
formal: At a naming feast in the village: a clean long dress of deep indigo wool with a white collar, a fresh white apron edged with a thin line of blue embroidery, a plain white shawl pinned at the chest, the white bun pinned with the bone hairpin. She stands upright with the small hands folded in front, a quiet, kind smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the bright new-leaf green eyes looking at the viewer with a calm, warm, reassuring look, a faint smile. Warm lamp light from one side on the snow-white bun and the deep lines. Foreground blur: a small silver scissors blade and drifting snow. She wears the indigo dress with the white apron.
